title.en: What is the weather like in ...?

summary: World map with weather symbols and temperatures for 15 cities; pair practice "Millainen sää X:ssä on?" following the model answer for Delhi.
transcript:
Malli:   – Millainen sää Delhissä on?   – Siellä on hyvä ilma. Aurinko paistaa ja on kuuma. On +39 astetta.
[Map] Nuuk +0 (cloud, rain/snow); Vancouver +9 (fog); New York +15 (cloud); Los Angeles +17 (sun & cloud); Berliini +14 (wind); Novosibirsk -5 (cloud, snow); Tokio +20 (sun & cloud, wind); Delhi +39 (sun); Dakar +25 (sun); Caracas +17 (rain); Nairobi +22 (thunderstorm); Singapore +28 (thunderstorm); Buenos Aires +15 (cloud); Kapkaupunki +19 (wind); Sydney +10 (sun, wind)

exercises.title: Millainen sää ... on? (map)
exercises.instruction: Ask and answer about the weather in each city, following the model.

items.en: What is the weather like in Vancouver? — It is foggy there. It is +9 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä on pilvistä ja sataa räntää. On 0 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Nuuk? — It is cloudy and sleeting there. It is 0 degrees.
What is the weather like in Los Angeles? — It is partly cloudy there. It is +17 degrees.
What is the weather like in New York? — It is cloudy there. It is +15 degrees.
What is the weather like in Berlin? — It is windy there. It is +14 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä sataa lunta ja on kylmä. On -5 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Novosibirsk? — It is snowing and cold there. It is -5 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä on puolipilvistä ja tuulee. On +20 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Tokyo? — It is partly cloudy and windy there. It is +20 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä on hyvä ilma. Aurinko paistaa ja on kuuma. On +39 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Delhi? — The weather is good there. The sun is shining and it is hot. It is +39 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä on aurinkoista ja lämmin. On +25 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Dakar? — It is sunny and warm there. It is +25 degrees.
What is the weather like in Caracas? — It is raining there. It is +17 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä on ukkonen ja sataa. On +22 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Nairobi? — There is a thunderstorm and it is raining there. It is +22 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä on ukkonen ja sataa. On +28 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Singapore? — There is a thunderstorm and it is raining there. It is +28 degrees.
What is the weather like in Buenos Aires? — It is cloudy there. It is +15 degrees.
What is the weather like in Cape Town? — It is windy there. It is +19 degrees.

items.answer: Siellä aurinko paistaa ja tuulee. On +10 astetta.
items.en: What is the weather like in Sydney? — The sun is shining and it is windy there. It is +10 degrees.
